name: rtl
note: Right-to-left scripts on Droid Arabic Kufi (Arabic with harakat/vowel marks and Arabic-Indic digits) and Droid Sans Hebrew (incl. niqqud vowel points). The reclassified known-gap string with ASCII punctuation in an Arabic run ('مرحبا! هل أنت بخير؟') measures through the engine's per-glyph script-run fallback, which resolves the missing '!' to the Latin fallback face the way Chrome's fontconfig does.

entries.text: هذا نص عربي طويل لاختبار قياس عرض النص في متصفح كروم

entries.note: reclassified from known-gaps: ASCII '!' in an Arabic run falls back per-glyph to the Latin face (Liberation Serif) via the script-run shim, matching Chrome's fontconfig resolution
